description: Post-1.0 Phase 28 — support/refund/restore runbook: triage channels, refund steps, restore purchases, known issues. Linked from support.html and in-app Settings.

triage.note: Prefer GitHub issues for bugs/crashes. Use email when attaching Play/web order ids for refunds.

steps: Sign in to the same Play Store or web checkout account used for the purchase
Open the harbor, then Goals (or Cosmetics)
Wait for the toast — entitlements grant idempotently (full harbor unlock + owned cosmetics)
If nothing restores, confirm the SKU is owned in Play → Payments & subscriptions (or web receipt email)

play.playerSelfServe: Play Store → profile → Payments & subscriptions → Budget & history → request a refund
play.consolePath: Play Console → Order management → find order → Refund
play.windowNote: Google may auto-approve recent refunds; otherwise handle via Order management within Play policy windows.
afterRefund: Entitlement remains on-device until the player clears app data or you revoke via Play (restore will no longer re-grant if ownership is gone)
Do not manually edit harbor_save_*.json to strip unlocks — use restore + store SoT

web.playerPath: Reply to the checkout receipt or email support with the order id
web.opsPath: Refund in the checkout provider dashboard, then confirm restore no longer returns the SKU
afterRefund: Clear pending entitlement ledger if a token was queued
Ask the player to Restore purchases once to sync owned=false

knownIssues.title: Private / blocked browser storage
knownIssues.workaround: Allow site storage or leave private mode; local slots need persistent storage.

knownIssues.title: Corrupt latest save slot
knownIssues.symptom: Continue fails or title shows recovery
knownIssues.workaround: Choose Recover previous on the title screen; AtomicFile keeps a previous backup.

knownIssues.title: Cloud sync on without Firebase keys
knownIssues.symptom: Cloud on, keys missing in Settings
knownIssues.workaround: Local play is fine. Set VITE_FIREBASE_* / fish.firebase.* to link remote saves; rules stay out of repo.

knownIssues.title: Restore finds nothing
knownIssues.symptom: Restore purchases toast says no purchases
knownIssues.workaround: Switch to the purchase account on Play / web checkout, then Restore again.

knownIssues.title: Frame stutter on mid devices
knownIssues.workaround: Settings → Quality → Low/Medium. Sim stays 20 Hz; quality only changes presentation cost.

faq.title: First session
faq.body: Fish → cut → stock → sell. Coaching advances on state events, not animation timing.

faq.title: Saves & recovery
faq.body: Local slots keep a latest and previous backup. If latest is corrupt, choose Recover previous on the title screen. Private / blocked browser storage falls back to memory-only.

faq.title: Purchases & restore
faq.body: Use Restore purchases in Goals after reinstalling. The one-time harbor unlock is idempotent; cosmetics are power-neutral banners.

faq.title: Refunds
faq.body: Android: request via Play Store Payments & subscriptions, or contact support with the order id. Web: reply to the checkout receipt with the order id.

faq.title: Performance
faq.body: Lower Quality in Settings if frames stutter. The simulation stays fixed at 20 Hz; quality only changes presentation cost.

ui.restoreHelpLine: Lost an unlock? Restore purchases in Goals, or open Support for refund steps.
